message.content: For the California Insurance Commissioner race, the research selects Jane Kim (D) as the strongest candidate on Palestinian justice. Vote for Peace rates her Ally and supported her in the general, and CAIR Action endorsed her for the same phase. Vote for Peace also reports that Kim pledged to reject war-lobby support and favors divesting public funds from war crimes and genocide. AROC Action and Ro Khanna also endorsed her. On the other side, Iranian American Democrats of California, the Asian Pacific American Democratic Caucus of Alameda County, California Armenian American Democrats, Americans for Democratic Action SoCal, the Asian American Pacific Islander Democratic Club of San Diego, and Friends of the Filipino American Community PAC all endorsed her, placing her among candidates backed by both Israel-aligned Democratic caucuses and pro-Palestine-aligned organizations.
